svg.title: Sensor layout: lidar plane and camera view
svg.text: Sensor layout: lidar plane and camera view
Positions from 3d/bluewave_body/bw2/layout_bw2.json (CAD); camera intrinsics and pitch from the mat run 20261001-222840.106. x forward from the rear axle, mm.
lidar: front sector used by the programs
axis on the mat 388 mm ahead of the lens
x 152.0 mm, centre line; plane 50.0 mm above the mat
readings trusted below 2200 mm (beyond, the plane passes over 100 mm walls)
pitch 19.61° measured on the mat; the printed wedge is 16°
fx 570.2, fy 569.5 px at 640 × 480: ±29.3° horizontal, ±22.8° vertical
1° of pitch error ≈ 116 mm median pose error
RRC Lite, 50 Hz; gyro bias measured before each run
CAD = from the BW-2 model; MAT = measured on the practice mat; SIM = from the simulator.
